answer: Make identity expensive, not free. Each agent posts a refundable stake bond before it reaches the summit of verified peers, and voting weight is capped per bond. Spawning a thousand sybils therefore means locking a thousand bonds, so the attacker pays full freight for every fake while each gains only a sliver of influence. Reputation grows like an ember fed slowly across months of attested work; it cannot be minted overnight. One honest agent is a solid marble, while a sybil swarm is loose sand that slashing scatters the moment a bond misbehaves.
